title: Perpendicular bisector
objective: Understand Perpendicular bisector through the chapter source and examples.
teacher_explanation: A line that bisects a segment and is perpendicular to it.

title: Equidistance property
objective: Understand Equidistance property through the chapter source and examples.
teacher_explanation: Points equidistant from segment endpoints lie on its perpendicular bisector.

title: Angle bisection
objective: Understand Angle bisection through the chapter source and examples.
teacher_explanation: Equal-radius constructions create congruent triangles and halve an angle.

title: Copying an angle
objective: Understand Copying an angle through the chapter source and examples.
teacher_explanation: Transfer an arc and its chord to construct a congruent angle.

title: Parallel construction
objective: Understand Parallel construction through the chapter source and examples.
teacher_explanation: Copy corresponding angles to construct a line parallel to a given line.

title: Regular hexagon/tiling
objective: Understand Regular hexagon/tiling through the chapter source and examples.
teacher_explanation: Six equilateral triangles produce a regular hexagon; angles around a point total 360°.
